beats.narration: Maya gathers launch work into one queue, tracks ownership, and follows each task to its outcome.
Maya opens Focus to see which launch commitments can move now.
Maya sees reviewer access, observability, and permissions ranked together with the next agent work.
Maya checks launch goals: 72 percent complete, one blocked item, and work still tied to outcomes.
Maya reads the ledger: claims, blocks, and review moves show who did what.
Maya schedules one Slack update from the ledger, giving the team one shared status source.
Maya shares a launch status she can trace back to the work, actor, and blocker behind every line.
